segment_id: '<set><NNN>:<s>' = segment s (0: [0, 10) s, 1: [10, 20) s) of clip <set>/<set><NNN>.txt (N ships .TXT); the last 3.6 s of each 23.6 s clip is not windowed
what: The folds the published Bonn numbers (Figure 8, App. D.1.3) were drawn on: stratified 5-fold CV over the 1,000 segments, as App. D.1.3 says. A clip's two segments are assigned independently, so in 770 of the 1,000 (fold, test segment) cases the other half of the same clip is in train or val.
derivation: probe_sz1_sklearn._build_patient_splits, 'Fallback B' (subjects == rec_ids == ''): StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=42) over arange(1000) on S-vs-rest, segments in clip-major order (sets Z,O,N,F,S; files sorted); val = inner StratifiedKFold(5, same seed) fold (k+1) % 5 of the outer train part.
evidence: Re-probing the paper's own Bonn CBraMod embedding on these folds with the paper's probe code returns its saved test probabilities to <= 2.6e-10, its best C and threshold, and its per-fold AUROC / balanced accuracy to 6 decimals; this release's extraction of that embedding equals it to 2.2e-7 in this segment order.
